Only 22% of 3,940 remote listings on Loker Dollar disclose pay. For brand designers, two fixed-price contracts stand out: $3,000–$5,000 and $1,500–$3,000. Here’s what that means for your next gig.

Among the 3,940 active remote listings, just 22% list a salary or rate. The two brand-design postings that do disclose pay show fixed-price contracts ranging from $1,500 to $5,000. Stevens (B2B SaaS logistics) offers $3,000–$5,000 per fixed project, and Sidekicks Creative Studio (street-food brand) offers $1,500–$3,000 per fixed project. Both are worldwide remote.

Other roles with disclosed pay: WTP Global video edits $800–$1,200 per fixed project; Love Isn’t Blind social video editor $1,000–$2,000 per month; South Digital ops lead $2,000–$4,000 per month. Love Isn’t Blind and South Digital are monthly retainers.

Contrarian take: chasing the top-end $3,000–$5,000 fixed contract can lock you into short, high-pressure sprints, while a modest $1,500–$3,000 retainer may provide steadier cash flow and room for upselling. Evaluate scope, timeline, and revision policy.

Next steps: Polish a logistics-oriented case study for Stevens, and join the Loker Dollar Slack community for early access to listings. Highlight any AI-enhanced workflow—companies like EY are investing heavily in AI-driven services, and the trend is spilling over into design contracts.

See all roles: https://lokerdollar.com/en/remote-jobs/design
